title: NexGen Writers - Stenograph
agency_path: City of New York > District Attorney - Bronx County
description_text: Pursuant to Procurement Policy Board Rules, Section 3-05, the Bronx County District Attorney intends to enter into a sole source agreement with Stenograph. for the the purchase of  NexGen writers. Stenographhas not issued any rights or licenses to others resellers. Any qualified vendor that wishes to express interest in providing such product and believes that at present or in the future it can also provide related product is invited to do so by submitting an expression of interest to ContractsBXDA@bronxda.nyc.gov.
